content.short: Foundation Subgraph enables developers to extract on-chain data from the Foundation NFT marketplace.
content.description: Foundation Subgraph indexes and organizes on-chain information from the Foundation NFT marketplace. It provides a GraphQL API endpoint that enables developers to query data related to NFTs minted on the platform and to obtain market activity insights. By using this subgraph, developers can access the on-chain information they need and build applications that interact with the Foundation marketplace, enabling dashboards, analytics, and experiences that respond to live activity on-chain.
